release.label: synthetic-evidence-freeze
release.purpose: Freeze synthetic PCC evidence and the pre-human analysis contract before any confirmatory HandHQ analysis.

human_data_gate.reason: Requires the applicable Georgia Tech ORIA/IRB determination or approval before confirmatory human-data analysis begins.
human_data_gate.source_scope: Future analysis is restricted to the approved HandHQ online-hand-history subset; televised WSOP, Pluribus, and named historical examples are excluded.

scientific_status.rule: Human results cannot change synthetic thresholds, component definitions, or claim statuses in this freeze. Any later change requires a new version and documented amendment before looking at the affected confirmatory endpoint.
